question: Related Questions Q. Zaakat is pending for around 30 years for Jwellery of my mother. Now we want to pay Zaakat now. Please let us know whether we have to pay zaakt of jwellery ,which is of gold and silver, of current price or we can calculate zaakat on the basis of old prices of gold and silver? 1857 views Q. Zakat on Property 2530 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1951 views Q. One bagger puton riksha a poudspeaker and bagging. We give him money that is right or wrong? 1455 views Q. Salary savings to buy flat 1877 views Q. Zakah on property 2296 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I love you for the sake of Allah (swt). I am salaried class and my questions are related to confusions in zakat and its calculations. Q1) I normally take a cut off date (usually 1st of Ramadhan) and calculate zakaat on my cash balance in my savings a/c?s. It is practically impossible for me to calculate how much of my savings have been with me for more than a year as the balance keeps on fluctuating as per my usage. The balance and savings are not much as I am salaried class but are more than the nisab value. This may lead to zakaat being calculated over the amount which has yet not completed one year in my savings. Is this acceptable? Q2) Due to prevailing recession my salaries are delayed from my employer. Now, I did my calculation of zakaat for this year on 23-08-09. On this day, my salaries for the months of May 2009, June 2009, July2009 were due for payment but not received. I would have probably had it in my savings had I received it on time. Do I have to include these amounts in my zakatable wealth? Q3) Similar to Q2, my bonus money for the year 2007-2008 is due for payment from my employer since 01-01-2009 but I am yet to receive it. Do I have to include this amount in my zakatable wealth? Q4) Similar to Q3, my bonus money for the year 2008-2009 will be due for payment on 01-01-2010 but on 23-09-08 (date on which I calculated this years zakaat) some portion of this amount had become due (about 65%). Do I have to include this amount in my zakatable wealth.? Q5) In my family and cousins there are many people who are financially weak but are reluctant to accept zakaat due to social reasons. Their fathers were wealthy and had fame but they are now poor. So they do not want to accept zakaat as according to them it will spoil their image. If I offer them loan or general help, for example if I give them money and tell them ?return it if you are able to in future? they will accept the money. Can I give them zakaat money and not tell them it is zakaat money?. Is it mandatory to tell them that this is zakaat money that I am giving you. Q6) Can I calculate my zakaat now and payoff partly in Ramadhan and partly in coming 2-3 months.?? Q7) If my zakatable wealth is Rs X and I have a dept of Rs Y, then the 2,5% is to be calculated on Rs X or Rs(X minus Y)?? Please reply as soon as possible. JazakAllah Khaire. 2505 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 147828 Country: India Title: Regarding zakah calculation Question: (1) I have an RD account in which I deposit 12000 Rs every month and I have been doing this since January 2016. So now I have (12*12000) Rs. And also my father sent me 1 lakh Rs in this month which I deposited in FD account. So how much zakah should I pay? (2) Kindly tell me details of calculating zakah. Answer ID: 147828 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 375/289/D=4/1438) You became sahib-e-nisab when you owned cash amount equal to 612 gram silver, i.e. zakah became fardh on you. Further, the amount which kept on increasing or decreasing during the year it shall be added in the same amount. When one year completes as per the lunar calendar i.e. from the time when you became sahib-e-nisab one year has completed then on the completion of the year whatsoever amount you keep in your hand you will have to pay its zakah, whether you owned some amount few days before completing the year. According to this calculation, you will have to pay zakah on total amount which you have saved and the amount which your father gifted you.(Fatwa: 375/289/D=4/1438) You became sahib-e-nisab when you owned cash amount equal to 612 gram silver, i.e. zakah became fardh on you. Further, the amount which kept on increasing or decreasing during the year it shall be added in the same amount. When one year completes as per the lunar calendar i.e. from the time when you became sahib-e-nisab one year has completed then on the completion of the year whatsoever amount you keep in your hand you will have to pay its zakah, whether you owned some amount few days before completing the year. According to this calculation, you will have to pay zakah on total amount which you have saved and the amount which your father gifted you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
